1.consolidated_definition: Examinar, ponderar, reflexionar. Considerar detenidamente un asunto. Calco de estructura, frecuente. Le voy a dar pensamiento a lo que plantea el comisionado
1.en_consolidated_definition: To examine, to ponder, to reflect on. To carefully consider a matter. Calque of structure, frequent. I will give thought to what the commissioner proposes.
